title: Build programs and typed clients
summary: Use Anchor for the default high-level program path; choose Pinocchio or generated clients only for a concrete low-level or maintenance need.

links.description: Build programs with account constraints, IDLs, clients, and an established test workflow. Anchor 1.x renamed its TypeScript client to @anchor-lang/core, which still depends on web3.js v1, so match the docs and package major.
Compare maintained native, Anchor, and Pinocchio samples without mistaking examples for deployed-app architecture.
Compare the standard program SDK with Pinocchio's lower-level, zero-dependency path before accepting its added validation burden.
Generate Kit-compatible TypeScript clients and documentation from Codama or converted Anchor IDLs.
